So his Wife took Boarders and did the Cooking herself.
Nearly Everybody Sympathized with her, because she had to put up with such a big Hulk of a no-account Husband.
One Day the Husband was Sunstruck, being too Lazy to move into the Shade, and next Day he Passed Away without an Effort.
